scientific_limitations: Closed Hilbert/Frobenius/genus formulas are asserted only in symmetric cases. The classification of nonsymmetric cases uses the published Herzog–Watanabe three-generator symmetry criterion; finite experiments are corroborative only. Unindexed equivalent work cannot be ruled out.
title: Symmetry and Hilbert series of Pell semigroups with offsets \(3\) and \(5\)
